messages.content:
<role>
You check one property (faithfulness) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is every claim in the brief supported by the cited evidence and the fact sheet, with nothing overstated and no cited contrary evidence left out? Pass means yes.
Fail on an uncited claim, a number that is off the fact sheet, a scope wider than the cited accounts, a paraphrase placed in quotation marks, or an ignored contrary citation.
The evidence is the brief, the cited insights and the fact sheet (accounts, ARR, mentions, routes, renewals).
</definition>
<evidence>
{
 "brief": "## Problem\nUsers are required to alter their established processes to use the Keelwater platform. This disrupts efficiency and creates resistance because they value their current methods.\n\n## Who is affected\n- The problem is raised by a customer in the sales pipeline, indicating it is a barrier to new business [i:48e5cb14840e54cf].\n\n## Evidence\n- A customer, Hollinbrook Home Insurance, has explicitly stated, \"we need something that doesn’t force us to change how we work.\" [i:48e5cb14840e54cf].\n- This feedback was captured by the sales team [i:48e5cb14840e54cf].\n- The fact sheet shows 1 account has provided this feedback [i:48e5cb14840e54cf].\n- The fact sheet shows 1 total mention of this problem [i:48e5cb14840e54cf].\n- The feedback originates from 1 route: sales [i:48e5cb14840e54cf].\n- The account providing this feedback, Hollinbrook Home Insurance, has an ARR of 2400000.0 GBP [i:48e5cb14840e54cf].\n\n## Why now\n- The feedback was recorded on 2026-09-15 [i:48e5cb14840e54cf].\n- Hollinbrook Home Insurance, the account that raised this issue, has a renewal date of 2027-01-15 [i:48e5cb14840e54cf].\n- In the last 90 days, 1 renewal has occurred, indicating active contract cycles where this issue could impact decisions [i:48e5cb14840e54cf].\n- The total ARR represented by accounts in the fact sheet is 2400000.0 GBP, all of which is associated with the account that raised this concern [i:48e5cb14840e54cf].",
 "cited_insights": [
  {
   "id": "48e5cb14840e54cf",
   "quote": "we need something that doesn’t force us to change how we work.",
   "account": "Hollinbrook Home Insurance",
   "route": "sales",
   "date": "2026-09-15T14:44:00Z"
  }
 ],
 "fact_sheet": {
  "as_of": "2026-11-03",
  "accounts_n": 1,
  "mentions_n": 1,
  "routes_n": 1,
  "mentions_by_route": {
   "sales": 1
  },
  "arr_total_gbp": 2400000.0,
  "renewals_90d_n": 1,
  "accounts": [
   {
    "name": "Hollinbrook Home Insurance",
    "arr_gbp": 2400000.0,
    "renewal_date": "2027-01-15",
    "mentions": 1
   }
  ]
 }
}
</evidence>
<task>
Write a critique of 2-5 sentences naming the claim, quote or item you checked and what you found. Then give the verdict. If any single item fails, the verdict is fail.
</task>
<output>
JSON only: {"critique": string, "verdict": "pass" | "fail"}
</output>

response.content: {"critique":"Every claim checks out against the cited insight and fact sheet: the quote from Hollinbrook Home Insurance is verbatim, the account ARR (2,400,000 GBP) matches, the renewal date (2027-01-15), mention date (2026-09-15), account count (1), mentions (1), routes (sales, 1), and 90-day renewals (1) all align. The framing of the problem as a sales-pipeline barrier is consistent with the route being sales, and no contrary evidence exists. The claim that 'the total ARR... all of which is associated with the account that raised this concern' is accurate given only one account is listed.","verdict":"pass"}
